Odalisque

Overview

The Odalisque is an enslaved woman in Kardaur’s household who says she has no name of her own. She steals the key to Zak’s cage, motivated by hatred of her master. Her father’s knowledge of the caves gives Zak an escape route through the Wormheads’ territory. She also explains how releasing the fortress animals can delay pursuit. [1, 2]

The Odalisque and the escape

The Odalisque approaches Zak after his ordeal. Enslaved by Kardaur and deprived even of a personal name, she wants his death and knows he will guard the gate that night. She steals the key to Zak’s cage. Her father, a rat hunter who disappeared in the caves, told her of the Wormheads’ temple and the bridges across its lava rivers. She uses that knowledge to explain a route the guards fear to follow. Zak kills Kardaur for the fortress key and escapes toward the cave; releasing the caged spiders can delay pursuit. The Odalisque and Zak part with wishes for each other’s freedom and survival, without a stated account of her later fate. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
